[Em7]pale when compared
[F#m]to the simi-

[G]clarity and
[Bm]there is purpose
[F#]after all, but

[F#]by your side.

[G]clarity... this
[Bm]tiny life is
[F#]making sense. and
[A]every drop numbs the
[G]both of us, but
